evidence.observation: Growth begins at 2.903 Torr, consistent with preceding ramp pressure near 2.9 Torr.
Pressure rises to 3.043 Torr following 2.981 Torr at 2640 s.
Pressure continues rising through 3.105 Torr at 2880 s to 3.184 Torr, about 10% above growth-start pressure despite unchanged setpoints.
Temperature has settled to 750.2 C against a 750 C setpoint.
Argon flow remains near its 100 sccm setpoint at 99.7 sccm; increased commanded or measured argon does not explain the pressure rise.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; atmospheric purity cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure trajectory and pressure tolerance; independent pressure confirmation and leak/exhaust-conductance checks to distinguish gas ingress from restricted pumping or other pressure changes; oxygen measurement to verify atmosphere; sample characterization to assess growth.
